newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Prudential to invest US$1.0 bln in Asia.
newsitem.headline: Prudential to invest US$1.0 bln in Asia.

text.p: British life insurer Prudential Corp said it was planning a direct investment fund of up to US$1.0 billion for Asian emerging markets.
The Prudential InvestDirect Asia Fund would make direct investments in Asia, including China, India and Vietnam, Prudential Corp said in a statement.
Initial funding was US$150 million, and Credit Lyonnais Securities Asia Ltd (CLSA) would source, structure and monitor the investments, Prudential Corp said.
It said Prudential Venture Managers Ltd, Prudential Corp's private equity arm, would coordinate investment activity, along with CLSA subsidiary Credit Lyonnais Securities Asia Private Equity.
Prudential Corp said it currently had more than US$140 billion of funds under management, of which US$13 billion was invested in the Asia-Pacific region.
